title: Semiconductor wafer drying (Marangoni drying and IPA drying) and preventing watermarks: ultrapure water rinsing and drying
excerpt: An explanation of rinsing and drying in semiconductor cleaning. In this Cleaning Level 3 lesson, with worked calculations, learn about rinsing with ultrapure water, what happens to impurities left in the water, why watermarks form, and the idea behind Marangoni drying. You can also review key terms and common misconceptions.
